title: 第13章 蓝色功法妖神邪丹第14章 开挂子弹拐弯
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 和之前一大堆的数量相比，眼前这几件自然不够看。
但每一样东西都明显更加高级！
最直观的方面，就是品质。
【回元丹】类型：消耗品。品质：绿色。介绍：一段时间内，快速恢复灵力。
【补血丹】类型：消耗品。品质：绿色。介绍：一段时间内，快速恢复气血。
《乾坤一掷》类型：功法。品质：蓝色。介绍：暗器法门，使用后可入门《乾坤一掷》。
【无生邪丹】类型：消耗品。品质：蓝色。介绍：催发欲念，让人嗜杀，邪瘾，狂躁，失去理智。
四样物品，最低的都是绿色品质，还有两个蓝色！
吴语扫过上边的东西，在看到《乾坤一掷》的时候心头激动起来。
《虎啸八斩刀》只是白色品质，尚且那么神奇，更何况是蓝色品质的功法？
而且，这是暗器法门，正是现在吴语最需要的！
原本他是想要杀死山贼弓手后，拿到一本箭术之类的功法卡，或者出去之后购买枪械之类的试试。
可现在......明显有更好的选择了。
想归想，吴语面不改色，平静地看向村长。
后者眼睛微眯，一直在打量他。
“不知这几样东西？”
吴语缓缓开口。
“老朽给小友介绍一番。”
闻言，
村长也不再观察吴语的神色，笑眯眯地说道：“两瓶丹药，一瓶可以恢复气血，一瓶可以恢复灵力，都是十枚！各售二十两银子！”
“《乾坤一掷》！此乃蜀地唐门秘籍，售五十两！”
“这一瓶是魔门丹药，售四十......算了，三十两就行！”
他犹豫了一下，好似是担心吴语不买，又急忙添了一句。
“相见便是有缘，小友无论买几件，我都给你少算几分！”
“小友，看这本功法，这可是秘籍！只需苦练半年即可入门，飞花摘叶皆可杀人！”
老头吹得口沫纷飞，吴语却面不改色。
他眉头微皱，故作不耐烦的样子。
“村长，就这些？”
“咳咳......要不之前的那些？”
村长尴尬一笑。
“之前的垃圾就算了。”
吴语摇头。
“这几个，全包起来吧。”
content_en:
Compared with the large number before, the few items in front of me are naturally not enough.
But everything is significantly more premium!
The most intuitive aspect is quality.
[Rejuvenation Pill] Type: Consumable. Quality: Green. Introduction: Quickly restore spiritual power within a period of time.
[Blood-Building Pill] Type: Consumable. Quality: Green. Introduction: Quickly restore Qi and blood within a period of time.
"The Throw of the Universe" Type: Kung Fu. Quality: Blue. Introduction: Hidden weapon method, after using it, you can start "Qian Kun Yi Throw".
[Wu Sheng Evil Pill] Type: Consumable. Quality: Blue. Introduction: It stimulates desire, making people bloodthirsty, addicted, manic, and irrational.
...
Of the four items, the lowest is green quality, and there are two blue ones!
Wu Yu glanced at the things above and became excited when he saw "The Throw of the Universe".
"Tiger's Roaring Eight-Zhanping Sword" is only of white quality, but it is so magical, let alone a blue quality technique?
Moreover, this is the hidden weapon method, which is exactly what Wu Yu needs most now!
Originally, he wanted to get a skill card such as archery after killing the bandit archer, or buy a gun after going out to try it.
But now...there is obviously a better choice.
After thinking about it, Wu Yu looked at the village chief calmly without changing his expression.
The latter narrowed his eyes slightly and kept looking at him.
"Don't know these things?"
Wu Yu spoke slowly.
"I'll introduce you to my little friend."
Hearing this,
The village chief stopped observing Wu Yu's expression and said with a smile: "Two bottles of elixirs, one can restore qi and blood, and one can restore spiritual power. They are both ten! They cost twenty taels of silver each!"
""The Throw of the Universe"! This is the secret book of the Tang Sect in Shu, sold for fifty taels!"
"This bottle is a magic elixir, priced at forty...forget it, just thirty taels!"
He hesitated for a moment, as if he was worried that Wu Yu wouldn't buy it, and then added hastily.
"We are destined to meet each other. No matter how many pieces you buy, little friend, I will give you a few points!"
"My little friend, look at this Kung Fu book. This is a secret book! You only need to practice hard for half a year to get started, and you can kill people even by flying flowers and picking leaves!"
The old man was frothing at the mouth while blowing, but Wu Yu didn't change his expression.
He frowned slightly, pretending to be impatient.
"Village chief, is that all?"
"Ahem...How about the ones from before?"
The village chief smiled awkwardly.
“Forget about the rubbish from before.”
Wu Yu shook his head.
"Wrap these all up."
